assigned_subjects.name: Las Golondrinas

administrative_findings.finding: 2017 statute assigns the zone known as Las Golondrinas to Imbabura Province and Cotacachi canton, effective on publication 2017-05-08.
2019 Cotacachi ordinance places the area in García Moreno parish, Cotacachi canton, Imbabura province.
A 2026-05-15 judicial venue resolution still describes the recinto in Cotacachi, Imbabura; this is dated corroboration and does not alter a physical boundary.

INEC/OCHA 2023 lists EC9001 under Zona No Delimitada, whereas 2024 gazetteer omits the code/name. This is an unresolved cross-vintage administrative data conflict; gazetteer omission does not mean the land disappeared.
2019 geoBoundaries role as canton conflicts with the statutory and ordinance role. Recommend engineering review of the Atlas source-role/tier metadata; make no hierarchy mutation in this packet.

physical_geography_findings.finding: 2019 geometry restoration path is verified and the complete feature is compared with the pinned Atlas geometry. A 9.841% source-area symmetric difference is material but does not adjudicate which boundary is correct.
One extremely small (0.136 m²) source geometry component is consistent with a digitizing sliver; it is not a defensible named-island finding.

No complete authoritative current physical land, water, coastline, island, or settlement inventory was established. The parent GSHHG centroid screen and local service reports are insufficient to establish completeness.

Five current indexed geometry contacts were assessed and are recorded with IDs and lengths. No area overlap was observed; source/legal neighbor consistency is unresolved. No cross-region boundary inconsistency was found.

Current complete parent chain was checked from location through Imbabura, Ecuador, Western South America, Andean South America, South America. Atlas political reference_owner is not treated as physical geography evidence.

assigned_subjects.bounded_next_action: Retrieve or formally document unavailability of a lawful current IGM/CONALI georeferenced boundary; reconcile it with the 2017 statutory coordinates, 2019 source feature and five listed contact neighbors. Until then retain the current stable subject and parent and make no geometry edit.
correction_proposals: Engineering should review and correct the metadata claim that this exact zone is itself a canton, using the 2017 law and 2019 ordinance as dated administrative evidence.
Do not alter the location geometry or parent membership on current evidence; present 2019/source and current contours as competing vintages for follow-up.
Do not infer political ownership from geometry, or geometry from the 2023/2024 administrative roster.

source_date_policy: Every administrative statement is tied to publication vintage; no undated claim of currentness is made beyond the latest retrieved primary record dated 2026-05-15.
shared_boundary_policy: No shared boundary edit proposed. Current-neighbor contacts are diagnostic only.
regional_scope: Western South America baseline; no inter-region inconsistency identified.
